newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent up, NYMEX choppy amid options expiry.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent up, NYMEX choppy amid options expiry.

text.p: Brent crude futures were higher on Thursday on extended short covering and supported by a firmer NYMEX contract.

April Brent was last traded at $19.67 per barrel, up six cents from London's close. May was last traded at $19.50, up 11 from London as players roll forward ahead of April's expiry on Friday and following the heavy April/May spread trade in London overnight.
NYMEX April crude was last traded at $20.90 per barrel, up 28 cents from New York. One player earlier pushed the contract as high as $21.11 in small volume to test sentiment above $21.00.
The firm NYMEX tone could also relate to players trying to push the front month towards a $21.00 strike price for options, which expire on Friday.
Brokers said the latest U.S. stock data was absorbed by the markets on Wednesday after the API data was delayed one day.
